{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1].index

print(f'Number of unique patient_id values: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Number of total rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}')

# Identify re-tested patients (multiple sample_seq)
retested_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f'Number of re-tested patients (multiple rows): {len(retested_patients)}')

# Show the duplicate patient IDs and their sample_seq
print('\nDuplicate patient IDs and their sample_seq:')
print(retested_patients[['patient_id', 'sample_seq']].sort_values(by='patient_id'))"}
